# Figure 6C reanalysis


## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/6C_distance-bins-mm10.tsv")
```
## Calculate reporter expression from two technical replicates
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pool = sub("_.*", "", pool_barcode),
    IR_expression = (expression_counts_1 + expression_counts_2) / (normalization_counts_1 + normalization_counts_2)
  )
```

## Summarize expression by distance bin
```{r}
# calculate median expression seperately for each mPGK pool
pool_summary <- df %>% 
  group_by(pool, distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(median_expression = median(IR_expression),
            .groups = "drop")
# calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_6C <- pool_summary %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
    sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pools = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
    
# calculate mean enhancer distance in each bin
distance_summary <- df %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
            n_IRs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# combine expression and distance summaries
summary_6C <- summary_6C %>% 
  left_join(distance_summary, by = "distance_bin") %>% 
  arrange(distance_bin)

summary_6C

# save the summary file
write_tsv(summary_6C, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_summary.tsv")

```
## Plot figure 6C
```{r}
p <- summary_6C %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_distance_kb, y = mean_expression)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
                  ymax = mean_expression + sem),
              fill = "steelblue",
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Figure 6C Reanalysis",
       x = "Distance from nearest enhancer (kb)",
       y = "IR expression") +
  theme_classic()

p

# save the plot
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 7,
       height = 5)

```
## Focus on IRs within 30 kb of the nearest enhancer
use 2kb as bin
```{r}
df_30kb <- df %>% 
  filter(distance >= 0, distance < 30000) %>% 
  mutate(distance_bin_2kb = floor(distance/2000)+1)

# calculate median IR expression for each pool and distance bin
pool_summary_30kb <- df_30kb %>% 
  group_by(pool, distance_bin_2kb) %>% 
  summarise(median_expression = median(IR_expression),
            .groups = "drop")

# calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_30kb <- pool_summary_30kb %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin_2kb) %>% 
  summarise(mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
            sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
            n_pools = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# calculate mean enhancer distance and number of IRs
distance_summary_30kb <- df_30kb %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin_2kb) %>% 
  summarise(mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
            n_IRs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
summary_30kb <- summary_30kb %>% 
  left_join(distance_summary_30kb, by = "distance_bin_2kb")

# plot the 0-30 kb region
p_30kb <- summary_30kb %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_distance_kb, y = mean_expression)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
                  ymax = mean_expression + sem),
              fill = "steelblue",
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 1) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,30),
                     breaks = seq(0, 30, 2)) +
  labs(title = "Figure 6C Reanalysis (0-30kb, 2kb bins)",
       x = "Distance from nearest enhancer (kb)",
       y = "IR expression") +
  theme_classic()

p_30kb

# save the result
write_tsv(summary_30kb, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_30kb_2kb_summary.tsv")

ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_30kb_2kb.png",
       plot = p_30kb,
       width = 7,
       height = 5)

```
